clips.title: The story
paras: Marleth Barleybrew sends a cask of Scalder toward the Thunderbrew Distillery in Kharanos. The ale is meant to prove his brewing against the Thunderbrews, his chief competitors.

The Thunderbrews and Barleybrews compete fiercely over brewing in Dun Morogh. The Thunderbrews are renowned, with their busy distillery in Kharanos. Marleth Barleybrew refuses to live in their shadow. He brews the fiery Scalder to show his recipes can rival theirs, hoping those who taste it will see the Thunderbrews do not own the art of fine dwarven drink.
